d:
Raaga Jeevana Raaga Is A Beautiful Evergreen Lyrical Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Shruthi Seridaga, Featuring Rajkumar, Madhavi And Geetha. The Melodious Music Is Composed By The Legendary T.G. Lingappa.
Enjoy This Timeless Kannada Melody And Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema. A Wonderful Classic For Fans Of Rajkumar Songs, Old Kannada Songs, Evergreen Kannada Melodies And Classic Kannada Movies.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: Raghavendra Rajkumar
Written by: Kumuda
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Madhavi, Geetha, Balakrishna, K. S. Ashwath
Music Director: T. G. Lingappa
